page_title: SAS 2-1 COM | Sassuolo v Como 17/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) but poses no threat.
88' 4:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
82' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
82' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty!
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alberto Moreno (Como) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
79' Alvaro Morata (Como) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
77' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Nemanja Matic is replaced by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
76' M'Bala Nzola comes off the pitch to be replaced by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo).
76' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is penalised for a foul. Francesco Fourneau had a clear view and blows his whistle.
76' Como failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' Maximo Perrone (Como) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
72' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) replaces Lucas Da Cunha.
71' Nico Paz (Como) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Stefano Turati.
68' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
64' Substitution. Cristian Volpato makes his way off the pitch and Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) comes on as his replacement.
64' The referee shows the yellow card to Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
63' Alberto Moreno (Como) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
61' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
60' The referee points to the corner flag and Sassuolo will take a corner.
60' Assane Diao goes off the pitch and Jesus Rodriguez (Como) comes on.
59' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
58' What an amazing save by Jean Butez! Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but fails.
52' Some patient build-up play from Como as they look to unlock the defence.
51' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) for his blatant foul.
46' Substitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) in, Martin Baturina out.
46' It is time for a substitution. Maximo Perrone (Como) is on for Maxence Caqueret.
46' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Ivan Smolcic will be replaced by Mergim Vojvoda (Como).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Francesco Fourneau has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 2 - 1 Nico Paz (Como) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 0 M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) collects a killer pass and fires a low shot into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 1:0.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Como comes to nothing.
42' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:1.
38' Assane Diao (Como) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
35' None of the Como players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
34' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Sassuolo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
33' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

32' Assane Diao (Como) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.
30' A cross into the box from Nico Paz (Como) is cleared.
30' Como take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
29' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) was too forceful with his tackle and Francesco Fourneau interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
27' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
26' Alvaro Morata (Como) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
26' Nico Paz (Como) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Stefano Turati has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
24' Maxence Caqueret (Como) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
22' Nico Paz (Como) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alberto Moreno, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
21' Assane Diao (Como) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
17' Sassuolo take a short corner kick.
16' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) releases a promising shot from the set piece towards the crossbar, but Jean Butez makes a save to deny him.
14' Jacobo Ramon (Como) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francesco Fourneau had an easy-decision to make.
14' A cross by Assane Diao (Como) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
13' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Kristian Thorstvedt, who fails to shoot.
9' Como string together a series of short passes.
5' Como work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

1' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Como will kick the game off.
Francesco Fourneau will officiate today.
